description: Organizations rebalance supply chains toward regional capacity diversification and resilience.
Tariffs sanctions export controls standards divergence and conflict disrupt global flows.
Extreme weather water stress heat and infrastructure damage disrupt production and logistics.
AI sensors digital twins robotics and traceability platforms reshape supply systems.
Energy transition demand strains minerals refining batteries and grid components.
Public procurement and regulation strengthen supply systems for essential goods.
Firms return to cost minimization after crises fade while hidden dependencies remain.
Repair reuse recycling product passports and circular material flows become strategic.
